info.title: User Management Service API
info.description: User Management is the sole RS256 token issuer. Gateway clients authenticate with bearer JWT; this internal API trusts gateway identity headers on an isolated network. Scopes follow resource:action and are advisory. Public POST operations: registration, login, refresh and client credentials. JWKS and health need no gateway identity. External callers use the gateway server and bearer tokens; internal X-Caller-Kind and identity headers are generated by the gateway and must not be supplied by clients.
